Hey there, so the plan we spoke of before was working for Dean's non-profit full time. I will be in their offices
tomorrow and Fri. I understand you will be back in NY next week- will you be needing me at all during the days
or is it safe to say I will be in all of next week and onwards..?
Btw, burning man was exceptional. During the day it's Mad-Max in a dust storm, at night it's the underground
cult from Neil Stephenson's Diamond age and Blade Runner in Fifth element attire set on the moon! Everything
at night glows (for safety reasons), which means 66,000 persons in LED, glow sticks, head lamps, flashing
jewelry, hats, etc. Bikes, aside from art cars, were the only other good way of getting around (the playa is huge)all have lights and are decorated wildly. The visual stimulation at night is overwhelming, and all of this elaborate
lighting is incorporated into each art installation. The evenings were such an adventure and Kimbal took me out
and showed me around every night. I can't even begin to describe how beautiful it was after sunset. Right out if
the best sci-fi novel :) Thank you! Thank you! --sending photos, but they hardly do justice to scale.

Sent from my iPhone
